name: Zendesk
tagline: Customer service platform with AI agents
description: Zendesk brings email, messaging, phone and social conversations into one place, with AI agents for resolving service issues across channels.
features: Ticketing across email, messaging, phone and social
AI agents included in Suite and Support plans, billed by automated resolution
Copilot, Workforce Engagement and Contact Center add-ons
strengths: Clear per-agent plan prices with monthly and yearly options
A 14-day trial of the Suite Professional features and a startup programme are described
limitations: Priced per agent, and AI resolutions are billed on top of the included amount
Enterprise pricing is by talking to sales

pricing.trial: A 14-day trial with access to Suite Professional features; Zendesk for Startups offers a 6-month trial of the Suite for up to 50 agents for early-stage startups.

plans.name: Support Team
plans.billing: $25 per agent per month billed monthly; $19 billed yearly
highlights: 5 included automated resolutions per agent per month

plans.name: Suite Team
plans.billing: $69 per agent per month billed monthly; $55 billed yearly
highlights: 5 included automated resolutions per agent per month

plans.name: Suite Professional
plans.billing: $149 per agent per month billed monthly; $115 billed yearly
highlights: 10 included automated resolutions per agent per month

api.summary: AI agents are billed per automated resolution: $1.50 each when committed and $2.00 each pay-as-you-go, on all three listed plans.

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign and no code; the FAQ lists USD, EUR, GBP and BRL as supported currencies. The page says annual billing is 20% off.

verification.notes: Product active. Customer Service view, per agent/month paid yearly: Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, Suite Professional $115, Suite Enterprise + Copilot by sales. Add-ons: Copilot $50, Workforce Engagement Bundle $50, Contact Center $83 per agent/month paid yearly. Monthly-billing prices ($25, $69, $149) are from an earlier check and were not re-seen.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI-first service platform for customer and employee requests

capabilities.title: Resolve requests with AI agents
capabilities.text: AI agents resolve issues autonomously on any channel.

capabilities.title: Help your human agents
capabilities.text: Zendesk AI automates common requests, suggests replies and summaries, and routes work; Copilot is a proactive assistant for service teams.

capabilities.title: Handle every channel in one place
capabilities.text: Customer Service manages and resolves inquiries across all channels.

capabilities.title: Serve employees too
capabilities.text: Employee Service resolves internal requests, including IT service management.

featureCards.name: Contact Center
featureCards.text: AI-powered voice and digital service in a unified system.

featureCards.name: Messaging, ticketing and knowledge base
featureCards.text: Live chat, tickets and self-service content.

featureCards.name: Quality assurance
featureCards.text: Built-in QA scoring for AI interactions.

featureCards.name: Workforce Management
featureCards.text: Forecasts, staffs and manages agent schedules.

featureCards.name: Marketplace
featureCards.text: More than 1,800 apps, partners and integrations.

featureCards.name: Standalone AI agents
featureCards.text: Self-improving agents through Forethought by Zendesk that work with an existing service platform.

audienceDetail.text: The site says qualified startups can get up to two years free.
The platform is offered to teams of all sizes.
Enterprise security and AI governance are highlighted.
Both appear among the industries named.

scenarios.title: Cope with volume spikes
scenarios.text: Automate a high volume of customer interactions, including around the clock.

scenarios.title: Handle employee IT and HR requests
scenarios.text: Run internal service alongside customer support.

scenarios.title: Run a voice contact centre
scenarios.text: AI authentication and routine resolutions on the phone.

scenarios.title: Build a self-service knowledge base
scenarios.text: Let customers find answers without a ticket.

gettingStarted.text: The site says no credit card is needed.

gettingStarted.step: Sign up with a work email
gettingStarted.text: Connect customer email and apps and invite team members.
